article.h2: How do I download a YouTube thumbnail in HD?
article.p: Paste a watch, youtu.be, Shorts, or embed URL that contains a public video ID, then download the first listed size. That file is the highest public still YouTube actually published.

ol.li: Copy the public video or Shorts URL from YouTube.
Paste it into the extractor on this page. Extraction starts when the ID is valid.
Download the top result, pick another surviving size, or copy the image URL.

article.p: Nothing is uploaded to an 11tik server. TikTok and Instagram are not supported because their public thumbnail endpoints are blocked for third-party sites.
article.h2: What thumbnail sizes does YouTube actually publish?
article.p: YouTube hosts several public stills for most videos. A maxres file, when published, is usually 1280×720. If that file is missing, the extractor ranks the next valid public size instead of inventing pixels.
Details are in the thumbnail size guide and the highest quality thumbnail page.
article.h2: How do I copy a working YouTube thumbnail URL?
article.p: After the valid sizes appear, use Copy image URL on the size you need. That copies the direct address on YouTube’s public image hosts, not the watch page.
article.h2: Can I extract a YouTube Shorts thumbnail?
article.p: Yes. Shorts URLs work the same way as watch URLs when the stills are public. The tool shows the real pixel size of each file instead of forcing a vertical export.
Standard watch URLs, youtu.be short links, youtube.com/shorts/, Vimeo watch and player URLs, and embedded or live YouTube URLs that still contain a public video ID.
Yes. There is no account and no paid download of the public thumbnail files. Processing stays in the browser.
A YouTube thumbnail is the preview image shown for a video or Short. This tool finds the publicly available image files YouTube hosts for that video.
article.h3: Do I need to install software?
article.p: No. The extractor runs in the browser. You do not install an app or browser extension.
article.h3: Does the tool store my YouTube links?
article.p: Pasted URLs are processed in the browser. They are not sent to an 11tik server. Optional local history stays on your device until you clear it.
